hero.eyebrow: A career and learning navigator for students
hero.headlineBefore: Not sure what's next? Find your
hero.subhead: Answer a few friendly questions. Explore possible paths and see why each one is relevant to you. Follow a clear map to build skills you can demonstrate.
hero.trustLine: Free to try. No wrong answers. Skip anything.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: Three short steps. You can stop and come back any time.

steps.title: Tell Lory about you
steps.description: A quick chat-free walkthrough, about 3 minutes. Skip anything you are not sure about yet.

steps.title: Explore possible paths
steps.description: See career paths with alignment and the reason behind each one.

steps.title: Build skills you can show
steps.description: A connected map of what to learn next, and challenges that prove what you can do.

features.title: What you get
features.intro: Everything you need to explore a path — nothing you have to pay for.

items.title: Possible paths, with reasons
items.description: Each path shows its alignment and why it is relevant to you.

items.title: Skill maps in order
items.description: See what to learn next and how each step connects.

items.title: Free learning resources

items.title: Proof of what you can do
items.description: Complete small challenges and track skills you have demonstrated.
